Frequently Asked Questions

How does PlanBot help busy professionals with unpredictable schedules?

PlanBot uses dynamic AI rebalancing. When a client meeting runs over or urgent fire drills occur, PlanBot recalculates your remaining workday with one tap, protecting your highest-priority deliverables.

Can I structure evening wind-down rituals to disconnect from work?

Yes! PlanBot includes structured shutdown rituals that help you review completed milestones, plan tomorrow, and power down without lingering work stress.
